topic: Wartime maintenance, procedure, authority to employ war time maintenance procedure schedule maintenance, component life defect rectification
syllabus_extract: Wartime maintenance, procedure, authority to employ war time maintenance procedure schedule maintenance, component life defect rectification and repair, BDR recovery to peace time documentation
specific_objectives: 1.1.5.1 Trainee will be able to understand modification, life categories and flight-testing effect of CG variation and wartime maintenance procedure

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of Wartime Maintenance Procedure Schedule and Component Life Defect Rectification protocols; Instructor supervision of documentation recovery simulation
intro_questions: What is the primary difference between peace time and wartime maintenance procedures?
Who holds the authority to authorize wartime maintenance procedures?
What is the immediate action required for a component life defect during wartime?

development.content:
Wartime maintenance procedure definition
Authority to employ wartime procedures
Schedule maintenance adjustments
Component life defect rectification
Modification and life categories

topics: BDR recovery to peace time documentation
development.content:
Flight-testing effect of CG variation
Defect rectification and repair standards
BDR recovery to peace time documentation
Impact on aircraft airworthiness
Reporting requirements for wartime repairs

topics: Transition from wartime to peace time status
development.content:
Review of wartime maintenance logs
Verification of component life limits
Documentation recovery procedures
Final airworthiness certification steps
Transition from wartime to peace time status

summary_questions: Explain the process of recovering BDR documentation from wartime to peace time status.
Describe the flight-testing implications of CG variation after wartime modifications.
Identify the authority responsible for approving wartime maintenance procedures.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the steps required to transition a wartime maintenance record to peace time documentation, referencing the procedures covered in this lesson and preparing for the Tool Control System introduction in LP 14.

pft_rows.syllabus: Tool control system – introduction and need of tool control set up, Tool control procedures, duties and responsibilities of tool controller, maintenance of tool out fits and procedure for use of forms TC-14, TC-15, LP tool procurement and survey/ demand of tool
